scope: Local engineering application model over audited entity/link/history/capture protocols. Atomic native proposal plus execution/analysis receipt and durable family-scoped recovery shared by core/HTTP/client/CLI. No new engineering primitive or universal lifecycle.

criteria.guarantee: Atomic native proposal and receipt; full rejection rollback and reusable identity
Exact native/content/link capture; explicit roles and trusted provenance; no observer IO during commit
Exact repeat and lookup across reopen/later edits; changed intent/provenance conflict; response loss and contention
Receipt-only no native revision; old table/payload/outcome preservation, immutable new ledger
Actual typed headless HTTP/session/client and CLI share validation/recovery and advertised feature
Two schemas/vocabularies share the operation; bounded coverage/impact retain scope, unknown state and independent review/outcome

applicationModel.composition: evaluations.commit snapshots invocation intent and trusted provenance, checks immutable prior success before live guards, shares transaction-local native and receipt handlers, and appends the exact result in the same repository transaction.
applicationModel.recovery: evaluations.getOutcome and exact repeat recover the original success without automatic retry. Changed intent/provenance conflicts. Rejected operations reserve no success. Null is not proof of in-flight failure.
applicationModel.storage: Physical format 11 adds immutable evaluation_commands with receipt foreign key; native and evaluation IDs use separate project/family namespaces. SQLite backup retains ledgers, recorded-project JSON excludes them.
applicationModel.projectSemantics: Engineering requirement/build/test_plan/test_run/verification_summary and research hypothesis/cohort/analysis_method/analysis_run/finding use distinct configured fields and connections; generic services retain explicit roles, captured states and scope.
applicationModel.bounds: 0–1000 native operations and existing receipt maximum of 100 total declarations; native/value and HTTP body guards unchanged. Outcome lookup selects one exact command. Coverage/impact keep page/population/work bounds and explicit cursor invalidation; no latency or arbitrary-scale claim.

limits: SQLite is the only executed adapter; no authenticated team/deployment/second-backend certification.
Simulated engineering/research data establish application behavior, not actual test execution, industry compliance or participant validation.
External observations capture identity/hash/revision metadata, not source bytes or automatic passage relevance/reanchoring.
No generic assessment API, receipt/review schema merger or universal verification/approval lifecycle.
No dedicated evaluation authoring UI added; shared typed transport and recovery are available to presentation callers.
Reopen and interrupted-response checks are not process-kill/power-loss or distributed-consensus proof.
Current operation/query bounds are explicit local contracts, not arbitrary-scale performance guarantees.
